repeat.body: Spacing is worked out from how you solved. Use this when you already know it has not stuck. It never asks twice in one day.
repeat.notePlaceholder: the part you could not see

review.cleared: That is the queue cleared for today.
review.dailyCapNote: How many due problems the queue offers at once. The rest wait; a backlog you cannot see is a backlog you will not abandon.
review.drillHint: Sixty seconds: which pattern, and why
review.repeatSolvedNote: Schedules every problem you solve to come back, and shows the due queue on the home page. Turn it off and the queue, the due badges and the Review buttons all disappear; the schedule keeps running underneath and picks up where it left off.
review.strictNote: While anything is due, nothing else opens. The home page, the collections and the other problems are all closed until the due problem passes its tests again. Reveal still works, but it does not open the gate — only a passing run does.
review.stuckNote: Out of the daily queue until the note is rewritten. Repeating a problem that is not landing costs the rest of the queue.
review.strictWarn: While the gate is up there is no way to push a problem to tomorrow: solving it is the only way through. This page stays reachable, so you can always turn the mode off.

review.heading: Review
review.blurb: Solving a problem once does not keep it. These decide how hard the workspace pushes you to write it again.

keyboard.heading: Keyboard
keyboard.blurb: Every shortcut the studio binds. The list is the one the handler reads, so it cannot drift from what actually fires.

language.blurb: Changes the interface and, where a translation exists, the problem text. Examples and code are never translated: the runner reads its test cases out of them.

verdict.chartThin: Not enough sizes were measured to fit a curve.
verdict.chartLabel: Measured time at growing input sizes. {{summary}}.
verdict.bigOLocked: Big-O is measured only once every case passes.
verdict.measure: Measure Big-O — time it at doubling input sizes and draw the curve
verdict.stubBody: Every export throws Not implemented. Write an attempt, save, then run.
verdict.missingBody: The file the runner was pointed at does not exist yet. Save once, then run.
verdict.loadErrorBody: The file could not be imported. Look for a syntax error - a stray bracket, or two exports sharing a name.
verdict.stalledBody: No answer after {{seconds}}s. A loop is not ending - check the condition that should stop it.
verdict.crashedBody: The runner died before it could report.
verdict.measuringBody: Each export is tested, then timed at doubling input sizes to fit a curve. This takes a few seconds.
verdict.runningBody: Each export is tested against the worked examples and any hand-written cases.
verdict.noRunBody: Save your attempt and run it. Cases come from the worked examples plus anything in tests/cases.
